title: 跟…一起: together with
summary: Lets you say who you do something with, as in 我跟朋友一起吃饭.
structure: Subject + 跟 + Person + 一起 + Verb
explanation:
跟 + person + 一起 + verb means 'do something together with someone': 我跟朋友一起吃饭 'I eat with my friend.' The whole 跟…一起 part goes BEFORE the verb, unlike English 'with my friend' at the end.

一起 alone also works when the group is the subject: 我们一起去吧 'Let's go together.' 和 can replace 跟: 我和他一起学习.

examples.en: He goes to the mall with his mum.

examples.zh: 你想跟我一起学汉语吗？
examples.en: Would you like to study Chinese with me?

examples.zh: 星期天我和爷爷一起跑步。
examples.en: On Sundays I go running with my grandpa.

mistakes.why: 跟…一起 goes before the verb.
The order is 跟 + person + 一起.

exercises.en: I go to school with my classmates.
why: Correct: 跟 + person + 一起 = together with.

exercises.en: I'm going shopping with my mum.
exercises.why: 跟 + person + 一起 before the verb.

why: Correct: 跟我一起 before the verb.
跟…一起 can't go at the end.
一起 comes after the person.

exercises.instruction: Say you do it together with your friend (朋友).
why: Correct: 跟朋友一起 before 去.
The 'with' part goes before the verb.
跟 must come before the person.
跟 needs a person after it.

exercises.prompt: Which asks 'Do you want to go with me?'
why: Correct: 想 + 跟我一起 + 去.
跟我 can't follow 去 like this.
